Name: Jehoahaz, Son of Josiah
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Josiah, was made king by the people of the land, reigned three months in Jerusalem, and was put down by the king of Egypt, who carried him to Egypt and fined the land.
KeyStory: The people took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah and made him king, but Necho took him to Egypt and made his brother Eliakim king.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah; Necho, King of Egypt
LifeLesson: A three-month reign shows how quickly a kingdom can change hands.
RelatedEvents: Fall of Jerusalem and the Exile
